clips.title: The story
paras: Across the eastern Barrens, Razormane spellcasters carry Fire Tar. Horde shamans use it to brew the Fire Sapta, which lets them commune with fire spirits.

Razormane geomancers, mystics, and thornweavers carry Fire Tar. The quilboar use the flame-tuned substance in their harsh magic and rituals. Shamanic instructors prize it as a worldly reagent that helps mortal senses reach the raw fury of the elements.

Young orc and troll shamans travel to Telf Joolam, high among Durotar's crags, to forge their fire totems. Telf asks them for a reagent pouch taken from Burning Blade cultists and Fire Tar gathered from the Razormane. He brews the two ingredients into a fire sapta. Drinking it lets a shaman perceive the fire spirits waiting atop the nearby peaks.
